- S 1. a motor vehicle which has no bodily injury liability bond or insurance policy in effect at the time of the accident.

- E 4. an underinsured motor vehicle which has liability protection in effect and applicable at the time of the accident but less than the applicable damages the insured person is legally entitled to recover. results.question: What is the maximum benefit for funeral service expenses under Coverage CC?

results.question: What is the maximum amount Allstate will repay for transportation costs from the place of theft or disablement?
results.expected_answer: Up to $10
results.evidence: Allstate will repay you up to $10 for the cost of transportation from the place of theft of your insured auto or disablement of the auto to your destination
results.llm_answer: Allstate will repay up to $10 per day for transportation costs after theft, with a maximum total reimbursement of $300. For disablement due to collision or comprehensive loss, Allstate will repay up to $10 for transportation costs, but no total cap is specified for these cases.

## COVERAGE DD Auto Collision Insurance

Allstate will pay for direct and accidental loss to your insured auto or a non-owned auto (including insured loss to an attached trailer) from a collision with another object or by upset of that auto or trailer. The deductible amount won't be subtracted from the loss payment in collisions involving your insured auto and another auto insured by us.

## COVERAGE DE Diminishing Deductible Auto Collision Insurance

If the loss is $100 or more, Allstate will pay for direct and accidental loss to your insured auto or a non-owned auto (including insured loss to an attached trailer) from a collision with another object or by upset of that auto or trailer. No deductible applies to losses in excess of $100.

## Premium Changes

The premium for each auto is based on information Allstate has received from you or other sources. You agree to cooperate with us in determining if this information is correct, if it is complete, and if it changes during the policy period. results.question: What is the outcome if Allstate broadens coverage during the policy period without an extra charge?
results.expected_answer: The policyholder automatically receives the new feature (if they have the applicable coverage).
results.evidence: When Allstate broadens a coverage during the policy period without additional charge, you have the new feature if you have the coverage to which it applies.
results.llm_answer: If Allstate broadens coverage during the policy period without an extra charge, the insured gains the new feature if they already have the coverage to which it applies.

results.question: If an insured person is using a non-owned auto, how does Allstate's liability insurance apply relative to other insurance?
results.expected_answer: It will be excess over other collectible insurance.
results.evidence: IF AN INSURED PERSON IS USING A SUBSTITUTE PRIVATE PASSENGER AUTO OR NON-OWNED AUTO, OUR LIABILITY INSURANCE WILL BE EXCESS OVER OTHER COLLECTIBLE INSURANCE.
results.llm_answer: Allstate's liability insurance for a non-owned auto is excess over other collectible insurance, meaning it applies only after all other collectible insurance has been exhausted.

results.expected_answer: The deductible amount will not be subtracted from the loss payment.
results.evidence: The deductible amount won't be subtracted from the loss payment in collisions involving your insured auto and another auto insured by us.
results.llm_answer: The deductible is not subtracted when there is a collision between an insured auto and another auto insured by Allstate.

## Part 2 Automobile Medical Payments Coverage CC

Allstate will pay to or on behalf of an insured person all reasonable expenses actually incurred by an insured person for necessary medical treatment, services, or products actually provided to the insured person. Payments will be made only when bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death is caused by an auto accident. Ambulance, hospital, medical, surgical, X-ray, dental, orthopedic and prosthetic devices, professional nursing services, pharmaceuticals, eyeglasses, hearing aids, and funeral service expenses are covered.

The treatment, services, or products must be rendered within one year after the accident. This will be extended to five years if the amount of insurance shown on the Policy Declarations for this coverage is more than $5,000.

results.question: What is the consequence if an insured person voluntarily makes a payment for something other than bail bonds or first aid?
results.expected_answer: Allstate cannot be obligated for that payment.
results.evidence: We can't be obligated if an insured person voluntarily takes any action or makes any payments other than for covered expenses for bail bonds or first aid to others.
results.llm_answer: The insurer is not obligated to fulfill its obligations if an insured person voluntarily makes a payment for something other than bail bonds or first aid to others.

results.llm_answer: If Allstate refuses to pay medical expenses deemed unnecessary and the insured is sued by a medical services provider, Allstate will pay all defense costs and any resulting judgment, and will choose the legal counsel for the defense.

results.question: What is the result if an insured person sues a responsible party for an uninsured motorist claim without notifying Allstate?
results.expected_answer: Allstate is not bound by any resulting judgment.
results.evidence: If an insured person sues a person believed responsible for the accident without giving us notice... we aren't bound by any resulting judgment.
results.llm_answer: Allstate is not bound by any resulting judgment if the insured person sues a responsible party without notifying Allstate in time to intervene.

results.question: What is the condition for an additional auto to be covered under Part 1 Liability?
results.expected_answer: Allstate must insure all other private passenger or utility autos the policyholder owns and notice must be given within 60 days.
results.evidence: This auto will be covered if we insure all other private passenger autos or utility autos you own. You must, however, tell us within 60 days
results.llm_answer: An additional auto is covered under Part 1 Liability if Allstate insures all other private passenger autos or utility autos owned by the insured, and the insured notifies Allstate within 60 days of acquiring the auto and pays any additional premium.

results.question: What is required for a hit-and-run vehicle to be considered an 'uninsured auto'?
results.expected_answer: Physical contact with the insured person or their vehicle, and the identity of the owner/operator must be unknown.
results.evidence: a hit-and-run motor vehicle which causes bodily injury to an insured person by physical contact... The identity of the operator and the owner of the vehicle must be unknown
results.llm_answer: A hit-and-run vehicle is considered an uninsured auto if it has no bodily injury liability bond or insurance policy in effect at the time of the accident.

results.question: Under what specific set of circumstances will Allstate pay for loss of clothing and personal luggage due to theft?
results.expected_answer: The entire auto must be stolen and the policyholder must have purchased comprehensive insurance.
results.evidence: Allstate will pay up to $200 for loss of clothing and personal luggage... This coverage applies only when... the entire auto is stolen, and you have purchased comprehensive insurance.
results.llm_answer: Allstate will pay for the loss of clothing and personal luggage if they are lost in the insured auto due to theft, and the items belong to the insured person or a resident relative.

results.question: Is a resident relative covered for medical payments if they are injured while operating a non-owned utility auto with the owner's permission?
results.expected_answer: Yes, because a utility auto is included in the definition of an auto, and resident relatives are covered while in any auto with permission.
results.evidence: 1. You and any resident relative who sustains bodily injury while in... an auto... The use of a non-owned auto must be with the owner's permission. AND 'Utility Auto' means an auto
results.llm_answer: Yes, a resident relative is covered for medical payments if they are injured while operating a non-owned utility auto with the owner's permission, as long as the injury results from an auto accident.

results.question: Does the policy cover bodily injury to a domestic employee if they are injured in a car pool while working?
results.expected_answer: The domestic employee is covered if not required to be under workers compensation, and car pools are generally not excluded by the 'carry persons for charge' rule.
results.evidence: exclusion... does not apply to shared expense car pools. AND This exclusion does not apply to your domestic employee who is not required to be covered by a workers compensation law
results.llm_answer: Yes, the policy covers bodily injury to a domestic employee if they are injured in a shared expense car pool while working, as long as the employee is not required to be covered by workers' compensation and the car pool is not for profit.

results.question: How are total disability benefits defined differently in the first year versus the second year under Coverage CW?
results.expected_answer: In the first year, it must prevent the person's own occupation; in subsequent years, it must prevent any occupation for wage or profit.
results.evidence: during the first year... prevents... that person's occupation; and during the second and subsequent years... prevents... any occupation or employment for wage or profit.
results.llm_answer: In the first year after commencement, continuous total disability means the insured person cannot perform all duties of their occupation. In the second and subsequent years, it means the insured person cannot engage in any occupation or employment for wage or profit.

1,	We", or "Us" \_\_ means the Allstate Insurance Company or Allstate Indemnity Company as shown on the Policy Declarations.

A "Auto" \_\_ means a land motor vehicle designed for use on public roads.

## Exclusions \_\_ What is not covered

This coverage does not apply to death:

- P a) operating, loading, unloading, assisting on, or performing any other duties related to the use of a commercial auto, or an auto hired or rented to others for a charge.
- M 1. sustained in the course of an occupation by any person while:
- b) repairing or servicing autos, including any related duties.
- L 2. due to suicide committed while sane or insane.
- E 3. due to any act of war, insurrection, rebellion, or revolution.
4. sustained while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck as a pedestrian by
- a) a vehicle operated on rails or crawler-treads;
- b) a vehicle or other equipment designed for use off public roads, while not on public roads; or
- c) a vehicle when used as a residence or premises.

## Payment Of Benefits; Autopsy

The benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's spouse. The spouse must be a resident of the same household as the insured person at the time of the accident. However, if the deceased is a minor, the benefit is payable to either parent. That parent must be a resident of the same household as the minor at the time of the accident. In all other cases, the benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's estate.

Allstate has the right and must be given the opportunity to make an autopsy where it is not prohibited by law.

## Consent Of Beneficiary

The beneficiary's consent is not required for cancellation, assignment, change of beneficiary, or any other change under this coverage.

results.question: If an insured's auto is being repaired and they use a rental car, is the rental car considered an 'insured auto' for liability and when would Allstate's coverage apply?
results.expected_answer: Yes, it is a substitute auto, and Allstate's coverage is excess over any other insurance the rental car may have.
results.evidence: A substitute... auto... used while your insured auto is being serviced AND IF AN INSURED PERSON IS USING A SUBSTITUTE... AUTO, OUR LIABILITY INSURANCE WILL BE EXCESS
results.llm_answer: A rental car used while the insured auto is being repaired is not considered an "insured auto" for liability; Allstate's coverage applies only after all other collectible insurance has been exhausted.

results.question: Under Coverage SS, does Allstate pay if the hit-and-run driver is identified but has no insurance, and what is the notification timeline?
results.expected_answer: Yes, if they have no insurance they are an uninsured auto, but for hit-and-run specifically, the identity must be unknown; notification must be within 30 days.
results.evidence: a hit-and-run motor vehicle... The identity of the operator... must be unknown AND We must be notified within 30 days.

results.question: If an insured person is injured in an accident involving a vehicle operated on crawler-treads, are they eligible for Medical Payments or Death Indemnity?
results.expected_answer: No, vehicles on crawler-treads are excluded from both coverages.
results.evidence: This coverage does not apply to... a vehicle operated on rails or crawler-treads AND This coverage does not apply to death... sustained while in... a vehicle operated on rails or crawler-treads
results.llm_answer: No, the insured person is not eligible for Medical Payments or Death Indemnity if injured in an accident involving a vehicle operated on crawler-treads, as such incidents are explicitly excluded from coverage.

results.question: Is a person covered for medical payments if they are struck as a pedestrian by a trailer designed for use with a private passenger auto?
results.expected_answer: Yes, because the definition of an insured person for medical payments includes being struck by an auto or trailer.
results.evidence: You and any resident relative who sustains bodily injury while... struck by, an auto or trailer. AND The trailer must be designed for use with a private passenger auto
results.llm_answer: Yes, a person is covered for medical payments if they are struck as a pedestrian by a trailer designed for use with a private passenger auto, as long as the trailer is not used for business purposes and the incident occurs during an auto accident.

results.question: Does Part 6 cover loss to a sound system that was installed by the car manufacturer?
results.expected_answer: No, the definition of a Sound System for coverage purposes requires it to be installed in a location other than the one designed by the manufacturer.
results.evidence: loss to any sound system... exclusion will not apply if you have purchased Coverage ZA. AND 'Sound System' ... which is installed in a location other than the one designed by the auto's manufacturer
results.llm_answer: No, Part 6 does not cover loss to a sound system installed by the car manufacturer, as the system must be installed in a location other than the one designed by the auto's manufacturer to be covered.

results.question: Is interest paid on damages that exceed Allstate's limits of liability?
results.expected_answer: No, Allstate only pays interest on damages not exceeding their limits of liability.
results.evidence: We will only pay interest on damages not exceeding our limits of liability.
results.llm_answer: No, interest is not paid on damages that exceed Allstate's limits of liability. Interest is only paid on damages up to the policy limits.

results.question: If Allstate pays for a loss under Part 6 and later recovers money from the person at fault, what happens to that money?
results.expected_answer: Allstate is entitled to that money up to the amount they paid, as the insured's rights of recovery become theirs.
results.evidence: When we pay, your rights of recovery from anyone else become ours up to the amount we have paid.
results.llm_answer: Allstate is entitled to repayment of the amounts it paid, along with related collection expenses, from any settlement or judgment recovered from the person at fault.

results.question: If a policyholder is using a non-owned auto for business, are they covered for liability under this policy?
results.expected_answer: Generally no, except for the policyholder using a private passenger auto or trailer, and even then only up to Nevada state law limits if the policy limits are higher.
results.evidence: exclusion... does not apply while you... are using a private passenger auto AND to the extent that the limits of liability... exceed the limits of liability required by the Nevada financial responsibility law.
results.llm_answer: No, the policyholder is not covered for liability when using a non-owned auto for business, as this use is excluded under the policy terms.

results.question: If a person is eligible for both Workers Compensation and Automobile Medical Payments for the same injury, what does Allstate pay?
results.expected_answer: Nothing, as medical payments coverage does not apply to the extent treatment is covered by Workers Compensation.
results.evidence: This coverage does not apply to any person to the extent that the treatment is covered under any workers compensation law.
results.llm_answer: Allstate will not pay for treatment that is already covered under Workers Compensation Law.

results.question: What happens if an insured and Allstate agree to arbitrate a claim over $3000 but then Allstate disagrees with the arbitrator's decision?
results.expected_answer: Either party has a right to a trial on all issues in a court of competent jurisdiction regardless of the arbitration method.
results.evidence: Regardless of the method of arbitration, either party has a right to a trial on all issues in a court of competent jurisdiction.
results.llm_answer: If Allstate disagrees with the arbitrator's decision, it may pursue a trial on all issues in a court of competent jurisdiction, as either party retains the right to a trial regardless of the arbitration outcome.

L E Your policy applies only during the policy period. During this time, it applies to losses to the auto , accidents and occurrences within the United States of America, its territories or possessions or Canada, or between their ports. The policy period is shown on the Policy Declarations.

## When And Where The Policy Applies

## Changes

## Premium Changes

The premium for each auto is based on information Allstate has received from you or other sources. You agree to cooperate with us in determining if this information is correct, if it is complete, and if it changes during the policy period. You agree that if this information changes or is incorrect or incomplete, we may adjust your premium accordingly during the policy period.

Changes which result in a premium adjustment are contained in our rules. These include, but are not limited to:

1. autos insured by the policy, including changes in use.
2. drivers residing in your household, their ages or marital status.
3. coverages or coverage limits.
4. rating territory.
5. discount eligibility.

## Payment Of Benefits; Autopsy

The benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's spouse. The spouse must be a resident of the same household as the insured person at the time of the accident. In all other cases, the benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's estate.

Allstate has the right and must be given the opportunity to make an autopsy where it is not prohibited by law.

The beneficiary's consent is not required for cancellation, assignment, change of beneficiary, or any other change

## Exclusions \_\_ What is not covered

This coverage does not apply to death:

- P a) operating, loading, unloading, assisting on, or performing any other duties related to the use of a commercial auto, or an auto hired or rented to others for a charge.
- M 1. sustained in the course of an occupation by any person while:
- b) repairing or servicing autos, including any related duties.
- L 2. due to suicide committed while sane or insane.
- E 3. due to any act of war, insurrection, rebellion, or revolution.
4. sustained while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck as a pedestrian by
- a) a vehicle operated on rails or crawler-treads;
- b) a vehicle or other equipment designed for use off public roads, while not on public roads; or
- c) a vehicle when used as a residence or premises.

## Payment Of Benefits; Autopsy

The benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's spouse. The spouse must be a resident of the same household as the insured person at the time of the accident. However, if the deceased is a minor, the benefit is payable to either parent. That parent must be a resident of the same household as the minor at the time of the accident. In all other cases, the benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's estate.

Allstate has the right and must be given the opportunity to make an autopsy where it is not prohibited by law.

## Consent Of Beneficiary

The beneficiary's consent is not required for cancellation, assignment, change of beneficiary, or any other change under this coverage.

## Proof Of Claim; Medical Reports

As soon as possible, we must be given written proof of claim. It must include all details we may need to determine if benefits are payable.

We must be given authorization to obtain medical reports and copies of records pertinent to the claim.

## Part 4 Automobile Disability Income Protection Coverage CW

Allstate will pay the weekly benefit shown on the Policy Declarations if an insured person sustains continuous total disability as a direct result of bodily injury, sickness or disease caused by an auto accident. ## Part 2 Automobile Medical Payments Coverage CC

Allstate will pay to or on behalf of an insured person all reasonable expenses actually incurred by an insured person for necessary medical treatment, services, or products actually provided to the insured person. Payments will be made only when bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death is caused by an auto accident. Ambulance, hospital, medical, surgical, X-ray, dental, orthopedic and prosthetic devices, professional nursing services, pharmaceuticals, eyeglasses, hearing aids, and funeral service expenses are covered.

The treatment, services, or products must be rendered within one year after the accident. This will be extended to five years if the amount of insurance shown on the Policy Declarations for this coverage is more than $5,000.

This coverage does not apply to any person to the extent that the treatment is covered under any workers compensation law.

## Insured Persons

1. You and any resident relative who sustains bodily injury while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck by, an auto or trailer. The use of a non-owned auto must be with the owner's permission.
2. Any other person who sustains bodily injury while in, on, getting into or out of
- a) your insured auto while being used by you, a resident relative, or any other person with your permission.
- b) a non-owned auto if the injury results from your operation or occupancy.
- c) a non-owned auto if the injury results from the operation on your behalf by your private chauffeur or domestic servant.
- d) a non-owned private passenger auto or trailer if the injury results from the operation or occupancy by a resident relative.

The use of non-owned autos must be with the owner's permission.

## Part 2 Automobile Medical Payments Coverage CC

Allstate will pay to or on behalf of an insured person all reasonable expenses actually incurred by an insured person for necessary medical treatment, services, or products actually provided to the insured person. Payments will be made only when bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death is caused by an auto accident. Ambulance, hospital, medical, surgical, X-ray, dental, orthopedic and prosthetic devices, professional nursing services, pharmaceuticals, eyeglasses, hearing aids, and funeral service expenses are covered.

The treatment, services, or products must be rendered within one year after the accident. This will be extended to five years if the amount of insurance shown on the Policy Declarations for this coverage is more than $5,000.

This coverage does not apply to any person to the extent that the treatment is covered under any workers compensation law.

1. You and any resident relative who sustains bodily injury while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck by, an auto or trailer. The use of a non-owned auto must be with the owner's permission.

- c) a non-owned auto if the injury results from the operation on your behalf by your private chauffeur or domestic servant.

## Part 2 Automobile Medical Payments Coverage CC

Allstate will pay to or on behalf of an insured person all reasonable expenses actually incurred by an insured person for necessary medical treatment, services, or products actually provided to the insured person. Payments will be made only when bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death is caused by an auto accident. Ambulance, hospital, medical, surgical, X-ray, dental, orthopedic and prosthetic devices, professional nursing services, pharmaceuticals, eyeglasses, hearing aids, and funeral service expenses are covered.

The treatment, services, or products must be rendered within one year after the accident. This will be extended to five years if the amount of insurance shown on the Policy Declarations for this coverage is more than $5,000.

This coverage does not apply to any person to the extent that the treatment is covered under any workers compensation law.

## Insured Persons

1. You and any resident relative who sustains bodily injury while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck by, an auto or trailer. The use of a non-owned auto must be with the owner's permission.

## Part 2 Automobile Medical Payments Coverage CC

Allstate will pay to or on behalf of an insured person all reasonable expenses actually incurred by an insured person for necessary medical treatment, services, or products actually provided to the insured person. Payments will be made only when bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death is caused by an auto accident. Ambulance, hospital, medical, surgical, X-ray, dental, orthopedic and prosthetic devices, professional nursing services, pharmaceuticals, eyeglasses, hearing aids, and funeral service expenses are covered.

The treatment, services, or products must be rendered within one year after the accident. This will be extended to five years if the amount of insurance shown on the Policy Declarations for this coverage is more than $5,000.

This coverage does not apply to any person to the extent that the treatment is covered under any workers compensation law.

1. You and any resident relative who sustains bodily injury while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck by, an auto or trailer. The use of a non-owned auto must be with the owner's permission.

- a) your insured auto while being used by you, a resident relative, or any other person with your permission.

- c) a non-owned auto if the injury results from the operation on your behalf by your private chauffeur or domestic servant.

## Part 2 Automobile Medical Payments Coverage CC

Allstate will pay to or on behalf of an insured person all reasonable expenses actually incurred by an insured person for necessary medical treatment, services, or products actually provided to the insured person. Payments will be made only when bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death is caused by an auto accident. Ambulance, hospital, medical, surgical, X-ray, dental, orthopedic and prosthetic devices, professional nursing services, pharmaceuticals, eyeglasses, hearing aids, and funeral service expenses are covered.

The treatment, services, or products must be rendered within one year after the accident. This will be extended to five years if the amount of insurance shown on the Policy Declarations for this coverage is more than $5,000.

This coverage does not apply to any person to the extent that the treatment is covered under any workers compensation law.

## Insured Persons

1. You and any resident relative who sustains bodily injury while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck by, an auto or trailer. The use of a non-owned auto must be with the owner's permission.
2. Any other person who sustains bodily injury while in, on, getting into or out of
- a) your insured auto while being used by you, a resident relative, or any other person with your permission.
- b) a non-owned auto if the injury results from your operation or occupancy.
- c) a non-owned auto if the injury results from the operation on your behalf by your private chauffeur or domestic servant.
- d) a non-owned private passenger auto or trailer if the injury results from the operation or occupancy by a resident relative.

The use of non-owned autos must be with the owner's permission.

## Insured Autos

- D 1. Any auto described on the Policy Declarations. This includes the four wheel private passenger auto or utility auto you replace it with.
- U 3. A substitute four wheel private passenger auto or utility

## Payment Of Benefits; Autopsy

The benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's spouse. The spouse must be a resident of the same household as the insured person at the time of the accident. - b) a vehicle or other equipment designed for use off public roads, while not on public roads; or
- c) a vehicle when used as a residence or premises.

## Payment Of Benefits; Autopsy

The benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's spouse. The spouse must be a resident of the same household as the insured person at the time of the accident. However, if the deceased is a minor, the benefit is payable to either parent. That parent must be a resident of the same household as the minor at the time of the accident. In all other cases, the benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's estate.

Allstate has the right and must be given the opportunity to make an autopsy where it is not prohibited by law.

## Consent Of Beneficiary

The beneficiary's consent is not required for cancellation, assignment, change of beneficiary, or any other change under this coverage.

## Proof Of Claim; Medical Reports

As soon as possible, we must be given written proof of claim. It must include all details we may need to determine if benefits are payable.

We must be given authorization to obtain medical reports and copies of records pertinent to the claim.

## Part 4 Automobile Disability Income Protection Coverage CW

Allstate will pay the weekly benefit shown on the Policy Declarations if an insured person sustains continuous total disability as a direct result of bodily injury, sickness or disease caused by an auto accident. ## Part 2 Automobile Medical Payments Coverage CC

Allstate will pay to or on behalf of an insured person all reasonable expenses actually incurred by an insured person for necessary medical treatment, services, or products actually provided to the insured person. Payments will be made only when bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death is caused by an auto accident. Ambulance, hospital, medical, surgical, X-ray, dental, orthopedic and prosthetic devices, professional nursing services, pharmaceuticals, eyeglasses, hearing aids, and funeral service expenses are covered.

The treatment, services, or products must be rendered within one year after the accident. This will be extended to five years if the amount of insurance shown on the Policy Declarations for this coverage is more than $5,000.

This coverage does not apply to any person to the extent that the treatment is covered under any workers compensation law.

## Exclusions \_\_ What is not covered

This coverage does not apply to death:

- P a) operating, loading, unloading, assisting on, or performing any other duties related to the use of a commercial auto, or an auto hired or rented to others for a charge.
- M 1. sustained in the course of an occupation by any person while:

- L 2. due to suicide committed while sane or insane.
- E 3. due to any act of war, insurrection, rebellion, or revolution.
4. sustained while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck as a pedestrian by
- a) a vehicle operated on rails or crawler-treads;
- b) a vehicle or other equipment designed for use off public roads, while not on public roads; or
- c) a vehicle when used as a residence or premises.

## Payment Of Benefits; Autopsy

The benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's spouse. The spouse must be a resident of the same household as the insured person at the time of the accident. However, if the deceased is a minor, the benefit is payable to either parent. That parent must be a resident of the same household as the minor at the time of the accident. In all other cases, the benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's estate.

Allstate has the right and must be given the opportunity to make an autopsy where it is not prohibited by law.

## Consent Of Beneficiary

The beneficiary's consent is not required for cancellation, assignment, change of beneficiary, or any other change under this coverage.

## Proof Of Claim; Medical Reports

As soon as possible, we must be given written proof of claim. It must include all details we may need to determine if benefits are payable.

We must be given authorization to obtain medical reports and copies of records pertinent to the claim.

## Part 4 Automobile Disability Income Protection Coverage CW

Allstate will pay the weekly benefit shown on the Policy Declarations if an insured person sustains continuous total disability as a direct result of bodily injury, sickness or disease caused by an auto accident. The injury must be sustained while in, on, getting into or out of, or when struck as a pedestrian by an auto , trailer or semi-trailer.

Benefits will be paid only while the insured person is alive and only if the disability:

If an insured person sues a person believed responsible for the accident without giving us notice so as to give us adequate time to intervene in a lawsuit, we aren't bound by any resulting judgment.

## Insured Persons

1. You and any relative who resides in your household.
2. Any other person while in, on, getting into or out of your insured auto with your permission.
3. Any other person who is legally entitled to recover because of bodily injury to you, a relative who resides in your household, or an occupant of your insured auto with your permission.

## An insured auto is a motor vehicle:

1. described on the Policy Declarations and the motor vehicle you replace it with.
2. D O 2. you acquire ownership of during the policy period. This additional motor vehicle will be covered if Allstate insures all other private passenger motor vehicles you own. You must, however, notify Allstate within 60 days after you acquire the motor vehicle and you must pay any additional premium.
3. C U 3. not owned by you or a relative who resides in your household, being temporarily used while your insured auto is being serviced or repaired, or if your insured auto is stolen or destroyed. The motor vehicle must be used with the owner's permission. It can't be furnished for the regular use of you or any relative who resides in your household.
4. M 4. not owned by you or a relative who resides in your household, being operated by you with the owner's permission. The motor vehicle can't be furnished for the regular use of you or any relative who resides in your household.
5. E 5. not made available for public hire by an insured person.

## Allstate Insurance Company

## An uninsured auto is:

- S 1. a motor vehicle which has no bodily injury liability bond or insurance policy in effect at the time of the accident.
- A 2. a motor vehicle for which the insurer denies coverage, or the insurer becomes insolvent.
- E 4. an underinsured motor vehicle which has liability protection in effect and applicable at the time of the accident but less than the applicable damages the insured person is legally entitled to recover. However, an underinsured motor vehicle is not an insured auto as defined under this coverage.
- M P L 3. a hit-and-run motor vehicle which causes bodily injury to an insured person by physical contact with the insured person or with a vehicle occupied by that person. The identity of the operator and the owner of the vehicle must be unknown or cannot be found. The accident must be reported as soon as possible to the proper authorities. We must be notified within 30 days. If the insured person was occupying a vehicle at the time of the accident, we have the right to inspect it.
5. a motor vehicle for which no evidence of financial responsibility is supplied to the Department of Motor Vehicles within 60 days after the accident occurs.

## An uninsured auto is not:

1. a motor vehicle that is lawfully self-insured.
2. a motor vehicle owned by any federal, state, or local government or agency.
3. a motor vehicle insured for bodily injury under Part 1 of this policy.

## Definitions

1. "Allstate", "We", "Us" , or "Our" \_\_ means the Allstate Insurance Company or Allstate Indemnity Company as shown on the Policy Declarations.
2. "Bodily Injury" \_\_ means bodily injury, sickness, disease, or death.
3. "Motor Vehicle" \_\_ means a land motor vehicle or trailer other than
- a) a vehicle or other equipment designed for use off public roads, while not on public roads,
- b) a vehicle operated on rails or crawler-treads, or
- c) a vehicle when used as a residence or premises.
4. "Resident" or "Reside" \_\_ means a person who physically resides in your household with the intention of continuing residence there. Your unmarried dependent children while temporarily away from home will be considered residents if they intend to resume residing in your household.
5. "You" or "Your" \_\_ means the insured person named on the Policy Declarations and that insured person's resident spouse.

## Exclusions \_\_ What is not covered

Allstate will not pay any damages an insured person is legally entitled to recover because of:

1. bodily injury to any person who makes a settlement without our written consent.
2. bodily injury to anyone while in, on, getting into or out of a motor vehicle you own which is insured for this coverage under another policy.

Allstate will pay to or on behalf of an insured person all reasonable expenses actually incurred by an insured person for necessary medical treatment, services, or products actually provided to the insured person. results.fact: Under Part 6 (If There Is Other Insurance), if there is other insurance covering the loss at the time of the accident, Allstate will pay only its share of any damages, determined by adding the limits of this insurance to the limits of all other insurance that applies on the same basis and finding the percentage of the total that Allstate's limits represent.

## Payment Of Benefits; Autopsy

The benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's spouse. The spouse must be a resident of the same household as the insured person at the time of the accident. However, if the deceased is a minor, the benefit is payable to either parent. That parent must be a resident of the same household as the minor at the time of the accident. In all other cases, the benefit is payable to the deceased insured person's estate.

Allstate has the right and must be given the opportunity to make an autopsy where it is not prohibited by law.

## Consent Of Beneficiary

The beneficiary's consent is not required for cancellation, assignment, change of beneficiary, or any other change under this coverage.

## Part 4 Automobile Disability Income Protection Coverage CW

Allstate will pay the weekly benefit shown on the Policy Declarations if an insured person sustains continuous total disability as a direct result of bodily injury, sickness or disease caused by an auto accident.
